outcome: success of trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: 301 women with antepartum fetal death diagnosed at ≥ 34 week's gestation and previous one low transverse cesarean section (LTCS)
finding: Several maternal features, including BMI, bishop score, and gestational age, were significant predictors of successful vaginal delivery in women with prior LTCS and antepartum fetal death.
